verdict.rationale: Vapi's pricing page says it uses a usage-based, pay-per-minute model with a free start, so the pricing structure is published. The evidence does not show actual per-minute rates or any way to estimate the cost of a call. Missing for 10: published per-minute dollar rates, a cost breakdown by provider (LLM/voice/transcriber/telephony), a per-call cost estimator or calculator, and independent confirmation of real-world call costs.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing

citations.quote: Get started for free, and then pay only for the minutes that run
